marks.gloss_en: אמאי לא טעמת מידי ואתית? -- why did you not taste something and come?
לא סבר לה מר להא דרב הונא -- one may not taste anything before praying musaf (= p_rav_huna_asur_litom_kodem_musaf)
ולא סבר לה מר להא דאמר רבי יוחנן: אסור לו לאדם שיקדים תפלתו לתפלת הצבור -- praying musaf alone first would put my prayer before the congregation's
לאו אתמר עלה אמר רבי אבא בצבור שנו -- R' Yochanan's prohibition was taught of one with the congregation (= p_r_abba_betzibbur_shanu)
Rav Avya: [I did not come to the lecture] because my heart was faint and I was not able
ולית הלכתא כרב הונא -- the halakha is not as Rav Huna (his prohibition on tasting before musaf)
ולא כרבי יהושע בן לוי -- nor as R' Yehoshua ben Levi (his prohibition on tasting before mincha once its time has come)
R' Yehoshua ben Levi: once the time of the mincha prayer has come, a person may not taste anything before he prays mincha

on his entering he says: May it be Your will, Lord my God, that no mishap occur through me, that I not stumble in a matter of halakha, that my colleagues rejoice in me, that I not call the impure pure nor the pure impure, that my colleagues not stumble in a matter of halakha, and that I rejoice in them

on his leaving he says: I give thanks before You, Lord my God, that You set my portion among those who sit in the study hall and not among those who sit on street corners; I rise early and they rise early -- I to words of Torah, they to idle words; I toil and they toil -- I toil and receive reward, they toil and receive none; I run and they run -- I to the life of the world to come, they to the pit of destruction

אילו לפני מלך בשר ודם... אף על פי כן הייתי בוכה, ועכשיו שמוליכים אותי לפני מלך מלכי המלכים -- before a mortal king whose sentence is not eternal I would weep; how much more before the King whose sentence is

were they leading me before a king of flesh and blood -- here today and in the grave tomorrow, whose anger, bonds and killing are not eternal, whom I can appease with words and bribe with money -- even so I would weep
תדעו: כשאדם עובר עבירה אומר שלא יראני אדם -- the transgressor fears only that a man see him
[asked to bless them,] he said: may it be [His] will that the fear of Heaven be upon you like the fear of flesh and blood
our master, teach us the paths of life, and we will merit through them the life of the world to come
be careful of the honour of your colleagues
when he saw them he began to weep
clear out the vessels because of the impurity
אמרו לו: מה מקום לתפלה זו? -- they said to him: what place is there for this prayer?
on entering, that no mishap occur through me; on leaving, thanks for my portion (= p_bichnisati_shelo_yeera_takala, p_biyetziati_hodaa_al_chelki)
R' Nechunya ben Hakana would pray a short prayer on entering the study hall and on leaving it
הני תמני סרי? תשסרי הוויין! -- are these eighteen? they are nineteen!
they are nineteen
ברכת המינים ביבנה תקנוה -- the blessing of the heretics: they instituted it in Yavne (= p_haminim_beyavne)
R' Levi: the blessing of the heretics -- they instituted it in Yavne
these eighteen -- corresponding to what?
R' Hillel son of R' Shmuel bar Nachmani: corresponding to the eighteen mentions [of the Name] that David said in 'Ascribe to the Lord, O sons of the mighty' (Ps 29)
R' Yehoshua ben Levi: one who prays must bow until all the vertebrae of the spine protrude
Ulla: until he sees an issar opposite his heart
R' Levi: for R' Hillel son of R' Shmuel bar Nachmani -- corresponding to 'the God of glory thunders' (Ps 29:3)
Rabban Gamliel: each and every day a person prays the Eighteen
R' Eliezer: one who makes his prayer fixed -- his prayer is not supplication
R' Yehoshua: one who walks in a place of danger prays a short prayer
one riding on a donkey dismounts and prays
Shimon HaPakuli arranged the eighteen blessings in order before Rabban Gamliel at Yavne
the next year he forgot it, and scrutinised [his memory for] it two or three hours
